```{r}
NRhits_narrow<- read.delim('/home/mad149/Metagenome_grassmere/NRCPAs_hit_per_sample.tsv', sep='\t', stringsAsFactors = TRUE)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)


hits_wide <-pivot_wider(data=NRhits_narrow, names_from=sample, values_from=count_hit)

hits_wide <- hits_wide %>% mutate(`32.3`=`1`+`2`) %>% select(-`1`, - `2`)
hits_wide <- hits_wide %>% mutate(`30.2`=`3`+`4`) %>% select(-`3`, - `4`)

hits_wide <- hits_wide %>% mutate(`30.8`=`5`+`6`) %>% select(-`5`, - `6`)

hits_wide <- hits_wide %>% mutate(`22.3`=`7`+`8`) %>% select(-`7`, - `8`)

hits_wide <- hits_wide %>% mutate(`17.2`=`9`+`10`) %>% select(-`9`, - `10`)

hits_wide <- hits_wide %>% mutate(`11.2`=`11`+`12`) %>% select(-`11`, - `12`)

hits_wide <- rename(hits_wide, `5.2` = `13`)

hits_wide <- rename(hits_wide, `3.4`= `14`)

hits_wide <- hits_wide[, c("protein_hit", "best_tree_CPA", "3.4", "5.2","11.2", "17.2", "22.3", "30.2", "30.8", "32.3")]

```



```{r}
hits_wide  %>%
  summarise(total = sum(`3.4`, na.rm = TRUE), .by = best_tree_CPA ) -> most_abundant34
most_abundant34$relative_abundance <- most_abundant34$total/sum(most_abundant34$total)
hits_wide  %>%
  summarise(total = sum(`5.2`, na.rm = TRUE), .by = best_tree_CPA) -> most_abundant58
most_abundant58$relative_abundance <- most_abundant58$total/sum(most_abundant58$total)

hits_wide  %>%
  summarise(total = sum(`11.2`, na.rm = TRUE), .by = best_tree_CPA) -> most_abundant112
most_abundant112$relative_abundance <- most_abundant112$total/sum(most_abundant112$total)

hits_wide  %>%
  summarise(total = sum(`17.2`, na.rm = TRUE), .by = best_tree_CPA) -> most_abundant172
most_abundant172$relative_abundance <- most_abundant172$total/sum(most_abundant172$total)

hits_wide  %>%
  summarise(total = sum(`22.3`, na.rm = TRUE), .by = best_tree_CPA) -> most_abundant223
most_abundant223$relative_abundance <- most_abundant223$total/sum(most_abundant223$total)

hits_wide  %>%
  summarise(total = sum(`30.2`, na.rm = TRUE), .by = best_tree_CPA) -> most_abundant302
most_abundant302$relative_abundance <- most_abundant302$total/sum(most_abundant302$total)

hits_wide  %>%
  summarise(total = sum(`30.8`, na.rm = TRUE), .by = best_tree_CPA) -> most_abundant308
most_abundant308$relative_abundance <- most_abundant308$total/sum(most_abundant308$total)

hits_wide  %>%
  summarise(total = sum(`32.3`, na.rm = TRUE), .by = best_tree_CPA) -> most_abundant323
most_abundant323$relative_abundance <- most_abundant323$total/sum(most_abundant323$total)

```



```{r}

hits_wide%>% separate(best_tree_CPA, c('Taxa_protein_id', 'CPA_subfamily'), '_Protein:')-> hits_wide

hits_wide%>% separate(Taxa_protein_id, c('protein_id', 'Taxa'), ':')-> hits_wide
hits_wide%>% separate(Taxa, c('Higher_taxa', 'Genera_species'), ';g__')-> hits_wide
hits_wide%>% separate(Genera_species, c('Genera', 'Species'), ';s__')-> hits_wide

hits_wide%>% separate(Higher_taxa, c('Class_etc', 'Family'), ';f__')-> hits_wide

hits_wide$Family[is.na(hits_wide$Family)] <- 'Eukarya'

hits_wide$`3.4` <- hits_wide$`3.4`/(sum(hits_wide$`3.4`))
hits_wide$`5.2` <- hits_wide$`5.2`/(sum(hits_wide$`5.2`))
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

taxa_first_to_last <- c('Haloferacaceae', 'Eukarya', 'Haloarculaceae',  'Halorutilaceae','Halomonadaceae',"Salinibacteraceae" ,'Nanosalinaceae', 'Microbacteriaceae', 'Nitrococcaceae', 'Pseudohongiellaceae', 'Vibrionaceae', 'Alteromonadaceae' , 'Cyanobiaceae', 'Rhodobacteraceae', 'Desulfobacteraceae', 'Pelagibacteraceae', 'Flavobacteriaceae' , 'UBA4575', 'Oleiphilaceae' , 'Burkholderiaceae', 'Porticoccaceae', 'BM103','Wenzhouxiangellaceae','Propionibacteriaceae','PWNQ01','CAYYUA01')

hits_wide$Family_rename <- factor(
  hits_wide$Family,
  levels = c(taxa_first_to_last, "Other"),
  ordered = TRUE
)
hits_wide$Family_rename[is.na(hits_wide$Family_rename)] <- "Other"

hits_long <- hits_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(protein_hit, protein_id, Class_etc, Genera,Species,
              CPA_subfamily, Family, Family_rename),
    names_to = "salinity",
    values_to = "count"
  )




```

```{r}


hits_long <- hits_long %>%mutate(salinity = fct_relevel(salinity, "3.4", "5.2","11.2", "17.2", "22.3", "30.2", "30.8", "32.3"))



ggplot(hits_long, aes(x =salinity, y=count, fill = Family_rename)) +geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.02)+scale_fill_manual(values = c('Microbacteriaceae' = 'gold2','Nitrococcaceae' = 'green','Salinibacteraceae' = 'red','Haloferacaceae' = 'deepskyblue','Haloarculaceae' = 'blue','Nanosalinaceae' = 'beige','Halomonadaceae' = 'cyan','Halorutilaceae' = 'aquamarine','Pseudohongiellaceae' = 'purple','Vibrionaceae' = 'pink','Alteromonadaceae' = 'salmon','Cyanobiaceae' = 'darkgreen','Rhodobacteraceae' = 'brown','Desulfobacteraceae' = 'brown','Other' = 'grey','Pelagibacteraceae' = 'darkseagreen','Flavobacteriaceae' = 'coral','UBA4575' = 'white','Eukarya' = 'orange','Oleiphilaceae' = 'lightblue2','Burkholderiaceae' = 'brown1','Porticoccaceae' = 'cornflowerblue','BM103' = 'darkmagenta','Propionibacteriaceae' = 'gray45','Wenzhouxiangellaceae' = 'chartreuse4','PWNQ01' = 'deeppink', 'CAYYUA01'='yellow'))
```
